role: Injection tokens for PostgreSQL connection pool providers
detail: Exports two Symbol-based DI tokens for PostgreSQL pool management: POSTGRES_ADMIN_POOL (admin credentials, DDL/DML, used only by initialization services for schema setup) and POSTGRES_RUNTIME_POOL (runtime user credentials, SELECT via RLS, injected into services needing read-only access). Enforces CANON §Drive Isolation: two-pool architecture prevents application from modifying drive rules. No classes, functions, or runtime code; pure token definitions for dependency injection.
